From: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Sent: Friday, January 4, 2019 3:56 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>
Subject: RE: Spring preview trip 
 
That pricing works for me.
Let me know when you have an idea of players.

From: Fenech, Anthony 
Sent: Friday, January 4, 2019 3:39 PM
To: Thomas, Christopher <cdthomas@freepress.com>
Subject: Spring preview trip
For the spring preview trip, which includes covering the fantasy camp, I priced it out at $723, which we can just round up to $800.

It would be a three-day trip, likely the week of Jan. 20-27, but there’s also a slim chance it can fall during the Jan. 28-Feb. 3 week. I’m working on seeing which players will be down there during those times for the season preview.
Ideally, I'd get something set up for the first week, then have a feature package on the fantasy camp for Sunday, Feb. 3, then do the spring preview stuff the next weekend.
